about: Music palette for reels. A reel names one entry (spec.music). Synthesized entries are regenerated to the reel's exact length by render.mjs (audio.py bed --style --key --seed); file entries point to a track Asaf supplied, with its licence. Only entries with approved: true can be published; approving a track is Asaf's call, by ear.

warm-d.mood: Warm and steady: soft electric piano, maj9 chords, no drums. Default for development, money and decisions.

reflective-a.mood: Thoughtful, a little serious: minor 9 chords. Stuck properties, families, risk.

open-f.mood: Light and open: sus and add9 chords. AI and systems topics.
